Claim: PM loop round 12 · `domain:cli` seat 2 · p2 · claimed under exception 2 (filer-labelled; the lane fits the table, and the body carries the filing gate's three answers) · it waited behind #24827, which landed as `19484af53` · 2026-10-20T15:19Z
Session: `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`
Account: `os-justin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24833-dev-recover-text`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24833`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `19484af53`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts`. The `recover` branch (about `:822`) prints "still in the v17 organization-ownership shape" unconditionally. The refusal it reacts to already says "17.x or an 18.0 pre-release". The sentence names the origin the guard names, or none.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`. The `serve --dev` child's start-failure output (about `:5810`–`:5830`, `restoreOutput()` / `printDiagnostic()` ahead of the ownership-refusal check, and the kernel's `Plugin startup failed` line) prints an `ERROR` line and a stack for a refusal `os dev` then recovers from itself. When the parent recovers it, the boot prints one plain account instead: what refused, that `os dev` upgrades in place, and where the copy is kept. A bare `os serve` refusal prints exactly as today.
- Measure first: which code prints the `ERROR` line and the stack. If its only producer is outside `packages/cli` (the kernel logger in `packages/core`), stop and report. Do not widen into another lane.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - the guard's refusal rule and text (`packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts`), and the ceremony;
  - which boots `os dev` recovers, and how (`utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts` keeps its behaviour);
  - the `[schema-drift]` `--allow-destructive` line, which is #24638's;
  - `packages/spec/**`.
- One `@objectstack/cli` changeset at `patch`: printed text of a development command.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: printed text of `os dev` and of its `serve --dev` child only. No accept set, no exit code and no refusal moves. If the diff moves anything beyond printed text, the dev stops and reports, and this line is re-judged.
Responsibility: this lane's CLI door (`packages/cli` `dev`, the follow-up to PR #24681). No platform path covers it. It reaches every `os dev` over a database an 18.0 pre-release or 17.x created.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `dev.ts`, `serve.ts` or `utils/dev-organization-ownership-upgrade.ts`. All 16 open PRs were read in this act.
- This seat's other card in flight, #24809 (PR #24873, the CORS doors), is disjoint. #24827 (PR #24875) has landed.
